'''''Starchaser IV''''' was a [[Wayfarer-class medium freighter/Legends|''Wayfarer''-class medium freighter]] that was owned by [[Cularin Star Tours]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
When [[Janvar Jan]] formed Cularin Star Tours, a company that hired luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] to tourists in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], he purchased ''Starchaser IV'' to serve as a safety ship to protect them, to satisfy his insurers. A crew from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was due to fly it, but when they failed to arrive, Jan hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to fly the ''Starchaser'' for a few days. They flew it around the Cularin system, dealing with various problems that the luxury yachts were experiencing.
